entries.description: Publicly disseminated or observable benchmark. Public access does not mean the methodology is open; the provider may still own and restrict the methodology.
entries.example_text: S&P 500: publicly quoted benchmark with provider-owned methodology.

entries.description: Rules-based quantitative investment strategy expressed as an index. It is commonly provider- or client-designed and may be public, restricted, or private.
entries.example_text: A bank QIS index with a documented ruleset and controlled distribution.

entries.description: Index whose methodology, calculation rules, or constituent process is owned or controlled by a provider or client. It may still have a public price or identifier.
entries.example_text: A provider-owned thematic or systematic index distributed to selected users.

entries.description: Bespoke index or basket maintained for a client, product, or internal use. Its constituent snapshots and rules are governed separately from this category code.
entries.example_text: A manually maintained client basket whose constituents are snapshotted over time.
